description: Sets or clears one status on a client, as the card's Manage menu does: deactivate (hides them from the clients list by default), block_booking (refuses new bookings for them), block_access (their portal sign-in returns no match), or unsubscribe (do-not-contact; on:true needs a short reason and stops every campaign and lead follow-up on that channel). on:false clears it (or re-subscribes). scope all or marketing and channel sms or email narrow an unsubscribe. These are the client's own statuses, not anyone's access to Sergio. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_client_status
title: Change a client's status
